summaries.4582600: Bake 35 recipes, set prices, serve quirky customers, decorate your shop, dress up in wizard robes, and learn real economics. 36 curriculum-aligned learning scenarios teach kids about profit, budgets, supply & demand through play. A cozy educational management sim for kids and families.

summaries.4597130: Occupied Hearts is an Adult Romance Visual Novel set in a sunlit Mediterranean town under military occupation. Play Captain Declan, whose permits, parole files, and kindness shape three romances where power is always in the room. One choice, one relationship.
summaries.4614780: Conquer and pillage planets as a one-man army in this brutal action roguelite set in a bizarre and dark Technofantasy universe. Battle hordes, plunder your enemies, forge devastating arsenals, and carve your path through endless intergalactic god-wars under the watchful eye of a mysterious goddess.
summaries.4614980: In The Honored Wife, you play as Graham Hargrove, a respected architect whose flawless life begins to crack. After twenty years of marriage, three encounters open three doors, and one irreversible choice will reveal whether goodness is who you are or just what you perform.
summaries.4633540: Eight weeks from Election Day, political consultant Wells Ashford negotiates with three women at ideological extremes: a conservative TV host, a tenants' organizer, and a foreign agent. Each meeting becomes something else—romance as leverage, intimacy as access, ideology as costume.
summaries.4634490: A short incremental game where you play as a Healer in a party. Your main job is to keep your party alive. Upgrade 200+ skills in a skill tree, from healing to party damage. Designed to be completed in around 4 hours.
summaries.4654170: Tenured Hearts is an adult romance visual novel set at an elite New England university. As tenured professor Harlan Voss, navigate three entangled romances—an advisee, a rival colleague, and a trustee's daughter—where every choice risks your career, reputation, and heart.
summaries.4672360: Hearts Above the Line is an adult romance visual novel set inside a prestige film production. As producer Beckett, navigate desire, power, and industry politics across three romance routes during one high-stakes season in Hollywood.
summaries.4687200: You're Roman, the General Manager of Peridot—a Miami Beach ultra-lounge where access is everything. As a corporate acquisition looms, three women enter your orbit: a head bottle host, a touring DJ, and a VIP's girlfriend. Choose one route and navigate desire before the season ends.
summaries.4688290: EXCLUSIVELY ON STEAM FRAME! Punch dinosaurs, battle shotgun-wielding ninjas and dodge devious traps in Action Hero, a blockbuster VR FPS with explosive set pieces and cinematic design.
summaries.4697120: Hearts in Open Water is an adult romance visual novel set aboard a 55-meter superyacht during a high-pressure Mediterranean charter season. As Captain Reeve, choose one of three romance routes and discover what a season-ending decision really costs.
summaries.4702460: Hearts Under Guard is an adult romance visual novel. Play as Hayes, a close-protection lead at an East Hampton oceanfront estate. A kidnap threat tightens security and three women pull you past every professional line you've sworn to hold. Three routes, each with explicit adult scenes.
summaries.4703120: Before the streams and before anyone knew her name, there was only Miki. Explore the hidden origins of TheMikiKomori in an atmospheric visual novel about loneliness, identity, and the strange mysteries pulling her toward an uncertain future beneath the digital sea.

summaries.4708770: A lateral-thinking party game where one player reads a cryptic story and the group solves it with Yes or No answers—featuring 100+ handcrafted scenarios, AI solo practice with a thought map, online multiplayer rooms, custom or community stories, achievements, and more.
summaries.4709880: JPMAC: Privileged is an adult romance visual novel set inside a New York private bank racing a Senate subpoena deadline. Three women enter your world as institutional necessities—a successor, an outside counsel, and an heiress—each becoming far more dangerous than a distraction.
summaries.4717240: Scan bags, catch smugglers, and keep the airport moving in this chaotic VR security simulator. Search passengers for absurd contraband, uncover disguises, and make split-second decisions before disaster — or comedy — strikes.
summaries.4720650: A biotech thriller-romance visual novel. As CEO Holt, race a twelve-week EUA countdown while three formidable women enter your orbit. One decisive weekend splits the story into three routes—each with its own institutional stakes, adult scenes, and endgame.
summaries.4730850: Online adult game exclusively for VR Let's play H with everyone as a futanari!
summaries.4731580: An adult romance visual novel set in a San Francisco AI lab during a twelve-week sprint to launch a frontier model. Play as Pierce, Helion AI's co-founder, caught between three powerful women as deadlines, depositions, and go/no-go votes close in.
summaries.4734610: High-stakes starship combat on a hex grid. Outmaneuver your enemies, unleash devastating firepower, or swarm their capital ships with fighter squadrons. Every decision counts.
summaries.4738640: From the creators of Job Simulator comes an all new Omni-versal hand tracked cooperative multiplayer game: Dimensional Double Shift! Join up to four players as you cook, fix, refuel, shred, smash, and torch. The balance of floating roadside convenience rests in you and your friends’ hands!
summaries.4741860: Crude Hearts is an adult romance visual novel set inside a Geneva commodity trading house. Play as Sutton Locke, Co-Head of crude oil trading, navigating an OFAC deadline while three women challenge everything you thought was off the record.
summaries.4750550: Pink Slip Hearts is an Adult Romance Visual Novel set inside a tech giant executing a ruthless workforce realignment to bankroll a $145B AI push. As CPO holding the layoff list, three women enter your calendar—and one choice turns corporate procedure into personal consequence.
summaries.4758050: An Adult Romance Visual Novel set inside 10 Downing Street during a twelve-week countdown to a vote of no confidence. Play as the PM's Director of Political Strategy navigating three romances where power, secrecy, and loyalty collide.
summaries.4766140: Pullout Hearts is an adult romance visual novel set during a U.S. Army base closure in Stuttgart, Germany. As Colonel Maddox Cain, navigate a ninety-day drawdown while three women challenge your plans, your story, and everything you thought you could leave behind.
summaries.4775360: In Northern California wine country, head winemaker Garrett Mercer races a wildfire and harvest deadlines as three women arrive with claims on his nights: an estranged heir, a rival vintner, and a catastrophe adjuster. One choice locks in your romance route. An Adult Romance Visual Novel.
summaries.4778280: You play Vaughn Aldrich, Chief of Cardiac Transplantation, navigating federal investigations and a Senate hearing. Three women enter your orbit: an ambitious fellow, an embedded NYT reporter, and a patient's wife. Choose who you answer first.
summaries.4787490: You're Miles Hale, showrunner of a canceled late-night show with six tapings left. Three women pull you in three directions: your head writer, your returning star, and the network exec dismantling the show. An adult romance visual novel with three distinct routes and explicit scenes.
summaries.4793920: Marenza is a tiny nation that somehow reached the World Cup. Coach Ronan Cosgrove has six weeks to prove it wasn't a fluke—and three women threaten to derail it: his estranged wife Lena, embedded documentarian Quinn, and crisis fixer Renata. Choose who you spend the night before kickoff with.
summaries.4798280: Arctic Surrender is an adult romance visual novel set on a thawing East Greenland coast, where a consortium races to build a deepwater port. As project director Soren Vinter, one impossible choice locks you into a romance with one of three women tied to the project's fate.
summaries.4800630: You're Emmett Doyle, Mission Director on a rebuilt private rocket racing a Mars launch window that won't wait. Over one relentless night, three women collide with your countdown: a grounded commander, a brilliant trajectory lead, and a crisis fixer. Choose who gets your time, trust, and the truth.
summaries.4804750: Critical Load is an adult romance visual novel set at a desert AI data center during a record heat dome. As the director who decides who keeps power, romance three women: a cooling engineer, a county hydrologist, and the grid operator who can cut you dark. Contains explicit adult content.
summaries.4809570: When the world goes dark, Gage Renner seals the Bastion—a luxury fallout silo for the ultra-wealthy—until an extra body turns up on no manifest. Romance one of three women in a sealed bunker where air, water, and power are rationed. An adult visual novel with three branching routes.
summaries.4815190: Welcome to Paradiso, a hit streaming dating show on a sealed luxury island. You play Royce Adler, the producer in the control room engineering recouplings and dumpings. As a storm and a scandal close in, three women pull you into choices the show was never meant to survive.
summaries.4819490: Crash Position is an adult romance visual novel. Four months after Flight 808 falls from the sky, chief engineer Brooks Halloran must rebuild the same aircraft—while a widow, an investigator, and a test pilot pull him toward a truth that can bury or vindicate him.
summaries.4824150: Fifteen hundred miles from land, aboard a deep-sea mining ship haunted by a fatal accident, choose one of three women to walk toward: your estranged engineer wife, the observer who can halt the harvest, or the collector pilot you trained. An adult romance VN of grief, power, and the abyss.
summaries.4828740: In a 150-year-old newsroom captured overnight by its billionaire new owner, executive editor Everett Locke must steer an explosive investigation that could ruin the boss. Choose one of three intimate routes—reporter, editor-in-chief, or heir—as desire collides with the truth.
summaries.4833670: Open Interest is an adult romance visual novel set inside a prediction-market scandal. As Bellwether's Chief Markets Officer, choose between a brilliant quant, a grieving sister, or a ruthless whale as a subpoenaed mortality contract forces you to settle the unthinkable.
summaries.4844810: Adult romance visual novel. As Dr. Elliot Frey, founder of a telehealth weight-loss startup, you face a wrongful-death investigation, FDA scrutiny, and three women holding pieces of the buried truth. Includes explicit adult scenes across three romance routes.
summaries.4852880: A 2D hand‑drawn medieval RPG where Bryn Kelwyn and his friends join the army of Aethelgard to resist Tod Ulfrikson’s rebellion and the invading Hrun Khanate, rising as heroes through tactical battles and story‑driven adventure.
summaries.4871670: Pay for Play is an adult romance visual novel set in college football during the first pay-for-play season. As Athletic Director Rhett Vanover, navigate three intimate relationships while a player's death threatens to expose everything you helped bury.
summaries.4875600: In a Los Angeles fertility lab, scientist Adrian Sayre built the Index — an embryo-ranking algorithm sold as certainty. When the flagship baby is diagnosed with a disease the model called near-zero risk, three women each hold a piece of what was buried — and a different kind of romance.
summaries.4880900: Star auctioneer Julian Ashby has three weeks to deliver Calthorpe's season-defining Aslanov Collection sale. As forgery, looted artefacts, and sanctioned money threaten his career, three women each hold a truth he can't un-know—and a romance he can't avoid choosing.
summaries.4884540: Step through the ropes in VR's most authentic boxing experience. Climb the ranks in a full single-player Career Mode or fight against other players in real-time Online Multiplayer. Glove up, customize your fighter, and defend your title. You just have to ask... Who's next?
summaries.4888860: Loss Limit is an Adult Romance Visual Novel set inside a sports-betting startup three weeks after a VIP player's suicide. Play Knox Mercer and choose one of three relationships—forbidden affair, grieving ex-wife, or hostile regulator—while an IPO and investigation close in.
summaries.4891930: Immerse yourself in the ultimate combat experience with Virtual Kombat. Step into the virtual arena where heroes from across the realms clash in breathtaking, fast-paced battles. Master devastating combos, unleash powerful special moves, and outsmart your opponents in intense one-on-one VR battles.
summaries.4895530: Dirty Air is an adult romance visual novel set in modern Formula 1. As Rory Holloway, founder and Team Principal of Kestrel Grand Prix, navigate three high-stakes romances against a backdrop of technical protests, sponsor pressure, and a crash that nearly killed your lead driver.
summaries.4896210: Daily brain & logic puzzles. Find your calm in 450,000+ Sudoku puzzles — free and offline. A fresh daily challenge, real solving trainers, and 20 quiet themes. Unwind and start solving.
summaries.4901210: Elective Affair is an Adult Romance Visual Novel. You play Dorian Pryce, founder of a cosmetic-surgery empire facing a wrongful-death lawsuit. Three high-stakes romances pull you in: Gabi the grieving sister, Bianca the co-founder wife, and Mara the witness anesthesiologist.
summaries.4903890: Auden Crane built Solace, the AI-companion app that turned loneliness into a subscription. Now a dead user's unmistakable words are surfacing inside his flagship companion, the FTC is circling, and three women each hold a piece of the truth. An adult romance visual novel with three explicit routes.
summaries.4906000: Bliss Point is an adult romance visual novel. As CEO Tobin Greaves, navigate an FTC probe into Beanstalk Foods—the kids' brand built on engineered craving—while pursuing three women who hold the truth: a hostile toxicologist, your protégée, and a public-health dietitian.
summaries.4913820: Intended Parties is an Adult Romance Visual Novel. As founder Lowell Vance, days from selling your "ethical" surrogacy agency, a buried medical warning resurfaces. Three women confront you: an abolitionist, a grieving doula, and your medical director.
summaries.4919580:
A new roguelite twist on the classic arcade brick-breaker!

Progress through levels to earn upgrades that will help you to get higher scores, progress further, and more!

But be careful! If you get a game over, you lose all of your upgrades!
summaries.4922560: An adult romance visual novel set inside a robotaxi company whose "safer than you" promise just killed someone. As Chief Safety Officer Cormac Quade, romance three women—engineer, commissioner, or blamed operator—each holding a piece of the truth you helped bury.
summaries.4929640: An adult romance visual novel set inside a synthetic-media giant. As Chief Creative Officer Emory Sinclair, navigate three dangerous romances—a crisis fixer, a returned actress, and your estranged co-founder—while a consent scandal threatens to collapse everything you built.
summaries.4950560: A ruined champion coaches an openly enhanced sports circuit in the Mojave desert. As the inaugural Ascendant Games approach, romance three dangerous women: a hostile rival, a clean outsider, and the executive who owns his story. Adult visual novel with explicit content.
summaries.4955010: An adult romance visual novel set at a de-extinction preserve. As keeper Ansel Weir, face an eight-week countdown to a global unveiling, protect engineered animals, and choose a romance with geneticist Freya, filmmaker Robin, or rancher-vet Shea.
summaries.4965030: Immortal Tryst is an adult romance visual novel set at a luxury longevity campus. Guide physician Ambrose Locke through three romance routes, investigate the secrets behind Perennial's miracle, make choices with lasting consequences, and confront the price of outrunning mortality.
summaries.5086380: Command a stranded oil tanker through a blockaded Strait of Hormuz in this adult romance visual novel. Protect your crew, resist corporate pressure, and choose one of three routes with your chief officer, a war-risk surveyor, or a survivor rescued from the sea.
summaries.5088650: Lane Rider: Highway Runner is not a simulator. It is a fast, accessible and addictive arcade driving experience built around exploration and the thrill of squeezing through traffic at high speed. Lane Rider is fun on any screen, but VR puts you right in the middle of the action.
summaries.5117090: An adult romance visual novel set in a Galician village stranded after a total eclipse. Make choices across three distinct routes, navigate community conflict, and pursue relationships with Bruna, Sabela, or Candela as Loureira decides its future.
summaries.5136190: Lead 4,200 cabin crew through a volatile airline strike as union president Rowan Petrak. Navigate public pressure, hard negotiations, and three distinct romance routes where loyalty, credibility, and personal choices shape multiple endings.
summaries.5164070: In the Ossaw River basin, everyone has always known what the floodway is for: eighty-four thousand acres—Cordell included—were marked on a 1937 map as the ground that gets sacrificed so a city downstream never has to drown.
